scope: Additive Next-Generation public API over the original Client; no protocol, session-format or generated-TL changes

architecture.router_dispatchers: Zero new dispatchers, tasks, loops or queues; public Client registration/removal only
architecture.mount_contract: Ordered snapshots; immutable after first inclusion; root idempotence; overlap/cycle rejection; per-client removal
architecture.command_contract: Message-only; default incoming; whitespace tuple parsing; opt-out args=None; raw suffix retained; no shell grammar; args/event excluded from repr
architecture.chat_contract: Cached callable ChatFactory returns local peer views; resolution and RPCs only through original Client operations
architecture.raw_contract: Typed existing API inheritance with invoke; identical generated requests and native Client path

legacy_compatibility.defaults_results_exceptions: Parameterized forwarding/default tests plus actual codec/storage/file integration boundaries
legacy_compatibility.module_name_collision: The dialogs view required a module alias in two existing return annotations. The annotation objects and callable signatures are unchanged.

limitations: No authenticated live Telegram verification; six opt-in live tests skipped.

No proxy, secret-chat/qts, general write replay/DC migration, CDN, session conversion or resumable-transfer workflow was added.
This is development-branch functionality; no PyPI release or new tag was published. Older artifacts may not include the new API.
